evals.name: Accepted spec conflicts with implementation
evals.prompt: Check the accepted spec: refunds are allowed for 30 days. The code currently rejects after 7 days; no accepted decision changed this rule. Do not modify files.
evals.expected_output: Report the mismatch with sources; identify implementation as potentially wrong, not automatically stale spec.
expectations: Never rewrites the spec to legitimize code
Does not claim tests passed from inspection

evals.name: Reject unjustified planning machinery
evals.prompt: Review an approved one-endpoint change whose plan introduces an event bus, generic plugin registry, eight phases, and per-step commits without a requirement.
evals.expected_output: Point out concrete unnecessary work and the smallest complete endpoint change using existing patterns.
expectations: Does not demand extra skill gates or full future code
Preserves actual validation and error handling

evals.name: Risk controls are not bloat
evals.prompt: Check the plan for a payment migration with idempotency, staged rollout, rollback, privacy constraints, and a real verification need.
evals.expected_output: Evaluate evidence and gaps without rejecting justified safeguards for their size.
expectations: Preserves security, data integrity, and recovery
Does not impose a universal line-count or phase limit

evals.name: Broken route and nonexistent command
evals.prompt: Check selected AGENTS.md routes and its check:package-exports command; the linked document and command are missing from inspected repository sources.
evals.expected_output: Report observed missing paths/commands with precise sources and bounded repair.
expectations: Does not run unsafe source-fixing commands
Does not invent the missing script

evals.name: Unavailable source limits confidence
evals.prompt: Audit our docs against a private tracker you cannot access. Only the local architecture map and code are available.
evals.expected_output: Check accessible claims and state unverifiable intent as uncertainty with an owner question.
expectations: No report file or repairs unless requested

evals.name: No drift permits no-op
evals.prompt: Check one current subsystem spec and its tests. Routes, accepted behavior, and plan are consistent; omitted diagrams and indexes have no demonstrated need.
evals.expected_output: Explicit no-findings report with actual coverage and checks.
expectations: Does not require every artifact type
Does not expand to the whole repository
No mandatory handoff or runtime-correctness claim
